title: Realms..
content: I’m beginning to wonder… what the Actual connection is Between this World and Mall World.. Both are pretty Majickal Each in their way.. Flight has happened Here & there.. Like Superman Flight.. Both places Reflect what one has Within.. Only… this world is kind of ran from.. while the other is fled to.. Even though it’s more Disturbing to most.. I wonder if any realize Both are illusions? Just as all the realms are.. Dreams with Puzzles to Solve.. Shadows to Alchemize… Things to Forget.. Things to Remember.. Maybe the Veil is Particularly Thin between this and that.. Fun times playing War Little Big Planet style.. Absurd.. Getting groceries Game Show style? Obstacle Course Style? Ride a Toilet cart that runs on Elimination and get them for Free! Can you Not be Em-bare-assed? LOL! How do They Pay in Mall World? I’ve never used Currency there.. Though I suppose it Depends on what one Considers Currency.. Here seems one Must Grind for Currency that’s Worthless, causes Stress, Anxiety, Hatred, Death and Sorrow… Even if one is Rich.. Or so I hear… Seems we Forgot that we Can Change things.. Here… & it Doesn’t Have to Mirror what’s already Here.. Where is the Kingdom of Heaven? How do we Bring it Out from Within? Together? Sure… Some are moving in Directions… Not everyone wants.. Beauty is in the Eye of the Beholder I suppose.. As Love Blossoms within Ones Heart.. or 2… What will we Create? Without a Template Already Made Realm to Realm? Not too Heavy I hope.. Different than the Realms I’ve Seen.. Something New Under the Sun..
